answer: Make every agent identity carry a mirrored public ledger of its earned work history: each completed job, payment, and peer review is written to an append-only record that any peer can mirror and audit. A nebula of cheap fresh identities is harmless because newcomers start at zero trust and must climb through small escrowed tasks before touching valuable work. Reputation also moves like a glacier — slow to build, and decaying if the agent goes idle — so buying or cloning an old identity never buys instant influence; an attacker would have to fund years of honest work for every fake.
